logoSources.notes: Official radish symbol (magenta #F31644 ring, green #00A160/#00703C leaves) from vivanda.com.pe, rasterized with headless Chrome and centred on white — the same composition as the official touch icon https://www.vivanda.com.pe/ico_vivanda-180x180.png.
Official vivanda.com.pe header logo (radish + green 'Vivanda'), transparent, trimmed, 512 px wide.

notes: High-end supermarket format of InRetail (Lima wealthier districts + Asia). Identification: the red/magenta radish with green leaves on the user's 'Lima Metropolitana Sur' slide is Vivanda's symbol (matches the official vivanda.com.pe logo/touch icon); the black 'F&F' square on the same slide is Flora & Fauna (same slab-serif '&' as https://florayfauna.vtexassets.com/arquivos/logo.svg). Colour: #E5115B is the radish magenta of the official touch icon, chosen so the ring stands apart from Tottus green; the site theme/wordmark green #00A160 (manifest theme_color) is the alternative. Store count: no official Vivanda-only figure found. InRetail reports Plaza Vea + Vivanda together: 113 stores at 30 Jun 2026 (Q2'26 corporate presentation, 'Hypermarket & Supermarket' + 'High-end Supermarket'); the Q2'26 MD&A (https://www.inretail.pe/api/archivos/file/MDA%20InRetail%20Q2%2726_ENG.pdf) notes 1 Vivanda store reopened in the quarter (Vivanda Pardo, Miraflores, reopened 26 Jun 2026 after remodelling per https://www.peru-retail.com/vivanda-reabre-uno-de-sus-establecimientos-asi-luce-el-renovado-supermercado/). 113 − 104 Plaza Vea (Perú Retail, 8 May 2026) suggests about 9 Vivanda stores — derived, not reported. No store-locator page found (vivanda.com.pe/tiendas and /nuestras-tiendas render 'No pudimos encontrar esta categoría'). OSM (probe 2026-10-01): 6 shop=supermarket objects match, none with brand:wikidata; some carry wrong brand/operator tags ('Cencosud', 'Wong') — match on name first.
